thumbnails.scene: The silver tabby cat sits on a wooden coffee table with one white paw pushing a white mug of tea over the edge, staring straight at the Geek, who sits on a brown sofa frozen with one hand reaching out and a flat deadpan face.
Close view of the silver tabby cat on a coffee table with its paw resting on a white mug at the very edge, its eyes locked on the Geek, who stares back with a flat suspicious deadpan look.
In a sunny bedroom the silver tabby cat on a wooden nightstand swats a black smartphone into the air, while the Geek sits up in bed with messy hair and a flat deadpan expression.

The silver tabby cat walks across a laptop keyboard on a wooden desk, a pen falling off the edge beside it, while the Geek sits at the desk with his hands frozen above the keys and a resigned deadpan face.

The silver tabby cat sits perfectly calm on a coffee table next to a white mug lying in a spilled puddle of tea on the rug below, while the Geek kneels with a towel looking up at it with a flat deadpan look.
